title_zh: ShadowFormer：全局上下文助力图像阴影去除
problem_statement: Existing deep shadow removal methods focus on local processing within shadow and non-shadow regions, leading to artifacts at shadow boundaries and inconsistent illumination between regions, while failing to exploit global contextual correlation.

contributions.text: Introduce a Retinex-based shadow model that formulates shadow degradation and motivates exploiting global contexts for shadow removal.
Propose a new single-stage transformer for shadow removal (ShadowFormer) based on a multi-scale channel attention framework.
Propose a Shadow-Interaction Module (SIM) with Shadow-Interaction Attention (SIA) to exploit global contextual correlation between shadow and non-shadow regions.
Achieve state-of-the-art performance on ISTD, ISTD+, and SRD datasets with up to 150× fewer model parameters.

method_overview: ShadowFormer is a transformer-based encoder-decoder network built on channel attention modules to hierarchically capture global information. In the bottleneck stage, a Shadow-Interaction Module (SIM) with Shadow-Interaction Attention (SIA) models the contextual correlation between shadow and non-shadow regions across spatial and channel dimensions, enabling non-shadow regions to guide shadow restoration.

key_formulas.semantic_desc: Decomposition of shadow image into shadow and non-shadow regions using a mask.
Retinex-based shadow model: shadow image is a composition of shadow and non-shadow illuminations multiplied by the same reflectance.
Correlation map between shadow mask patches i and j, used in SIA.
Shadow-Interaction Attention: reweights attention map by correlation map to emphasize shadow-non-shadow context.
L1 loss between ground truth and predicted shadow-free image.

key_figures.caption: The PSNR performance, v.s., the number of model parameters of shadow removal models on ISTD dataset.
key_figures.role: Shows that ShadowFormer achieves high PSNR with far fewer parameters compared to other methods.

key_figures.caption: Overview of the ShadowFormer network. The channel attention transformer-based encoder and decoder extract hierarchical information; the bottleneck stage uses SIM to exploit context from non-shadow regions.
key_figures.role: Illustrates the overall architecture of ShadowFormer.

key_figures.caption: Detailed architectures: (a) Channel Attention Module; (b) Shadow-Interaction Module with Shadow-Interaction Attention, reweighting attention by correlation map.
key_figures.role: Shows the internal structure of CA and SIM/SIA modules.

key_figures.caption: Visual examples of ablation study results, zoom-in regions, and error maps.
key_figures.role: Demonstrates the contribution of each component through visual comparisons.

experiments.main_results: ShadowFormer achieves state-of-the-art PSNR/SSIM on all three datasets with up to 150× fewer parameters than competing methods.
takeaways: The proposed method effectively removes shadows while maintaining illumination consistency and reducing boundary artifacts

conclusion: The paper proposes a Retinex-based shadow model and a novel transformer network (ShadowFormer) with a Shadow-Interaction Module that exploits global contextual correlation between shadow and non-shadow regions. The method achieves state-of-the-art performance on multiple datasets with significantly fewer parameters.
full_analysis_md: # ShadowFormer: Global Context Helps Image Shadow Removal ## Problem Statement Existing deep shadow removal methods focus on local processing within shadow and non-shadow regions, leading to artifacts at shadow boundaries and inconsistent illumination between regions, while failing to exploit global contextual correlation. ## Contributions 1. **Retinex-based shadow model**: Formulates shadow degradation and motivates exploiting global contexts. 2. **ShadowFormer**: A single-stage transformer network based on multi-scale channel attention. 3. **Shadow-Interaction Module (SIM) with Shadow-Interaction Attention (SIA)**: Models global contextual correlation between shadow and non-shadow regions. 4. **State-of-the-art performance**: Achieves best results on ISTD, ISTD+, SRD with up to 150× fewer parameters. ## Method Overview ShadowFormer is a transformer-based encoder-decoder network built on channel attention modules to hierarchically capture global information. In the bottleneck stage, a Shadow-Interaction Module (SIM) with Shadow-Interaction Attention (SIA) models the contextual correlation between shadow and non-shadow regions across spatial and channel dimensions, enabling non-shadow regions to guide shadow restoration. ## Key Formulas 1. **Shadow image decomposition**: \(\mathbf{I}_{s}= \mathbf{I}_m \odot \mathbf{I}_{s} + (1-\mathbf{I}_m) \odot \mathbf{I}_{ns}\) 2. **Retinex-based shadow model**: \(\mathbf{I}_{s} = \mathbf{I}_m \odot \mathbf{L}_{s} \odot \mathbf{R} + (1-\mathbf{I}_m) \odot \mathbf{L}_{ns} \odot \mathbf{R}\) 3. **Correlation map**: \(\mathbf{\Sigma}^{ij} = \mathbf{M}^i\oplus \mathbf{M}^j\) 4. **Shadow-Interaction Attention**: \(\text{SIA}(\mathbf{X}, \mathbf{\Sigma}) = \text{softmax}(\frac{\mathbf{Q}\mathbf{K}^T}{d})\mathbf{V}\) 5. **Loss function**: \(\mathcal{L}(\mathbf{I}_{g t},\; \hat{\mathbf{I}})=\left\|\mathbf{I}_{g t}-\hat{\mathbf{I}}\right\|\) ## Key Figures 1. **fig:intro**: PSNR vs. parameters on ISTD, showing efficiency. 2. **fig:pipeline**: Overall architecture of ShadowFormer. 3. **fig:masksa**: Detailed CA and SIM/SIA modules. 4. **fig:ablation**: Visual ablation study results. ## Experiments - **Datasets**: ISTD, ISTD+, SRD - **Metrics**: PSNR, SSIM, RMSE - **Main Results**: ShadowFormer achieves state-of-the-art on all datasets with up to 150× fewer parameters. - **Takeaways**: Effective shadow removal with consistent illumination and reduced artifacts, lightweight model. ## Conclusion The paper proposes a Retinex-based shadow model and a novel transformer network (ShadowFormer) with a Shadow-Interaction Module that exploits global contextual correlation between shadow and non-shadow regions. The method achieves state-of-the-art performance on multiple datasets with significantly fewer parameters. ## Code https://github.com/GuoLanqing/ShadowFormer
